original_test_intent: Verify the canonical SMBIOS Type 2 Base Board Type enumeration for the intended board matches its approved role and remains stable after reboot; the doubled words in the source label are not a separate field.
original_method: Preserve complete Type 2 records, map the intended board using identity/BOM/location, extract its canonical Type field and underlying enumeration, compare with the approved board role, reboot and repeat.
manual_activity: A user approves the typo-to-field mapping, expected board role and reboot plan. Core extraction, enumeration validation and persistence comparison are automatable.
required_inputs: Approved mapping from source label to canonical Type 2 Type field
safety_requirements: Read SMBIOS only and retain raw Type 2 records/errors.
Do not execute the doubled label grep as authoritative or accept an empty result.
Do not confuse Type 2 board Type with Type 3 chassis Type, product name or feature flags.
Reject out-of-range/reserved values and wrong-board selection; stop on drift or reboot failure.
agent_execution_scope: Collect all Type 2 records, bind the intended board, normalize its canonical Type enum/display value and compare before/after reboot.
Do not modify DMI, invent an enumeration mapping or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the source-label correction, target board role and expected enum/value.
Resolve role or enumeration discrepancies and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not directly applicable because the literal doubled label is not the canonical decoded field; it also discards errors, loses board-record provenance and assumes insecure transport.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the source wording for provenance, archive complete Type 2 output/tool version/errors and parse the canonical record-scoped `Type` field plus its enumeration for the approved board.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The exact doubled source label, linked script and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Normalize only the label to the canonical Type 2 Type field, select the board by correlated identity, compare both decoded role and raw enum against the applicable SMBIOS/platform baseline, and retain the same mapping across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, dmidecode, BIOS and BOM revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 2 Base Board Type enumeration and installed dmidecode documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Corrects field extraction and adds enum/board provenance without rewriting the original source text.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Canonical mapping, expected enum and board role.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A decoded label may vary by tool version; raw enumeration and specification version should remain available.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve the applicable board role for a particular Type 2 record, but must retain the raw enumeration and cannot substitute Type 3 chassis classification.
expected_evidence: Approval, typo mapping, expected board-type enum/role and tool/SMBIOS versions
Complete pre-reboot Type 2 records plus selected raw/decoded Type

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The doubled wording is an unambiguous editorial error within the Type 2 context; canonical field semantics resolve it without competing test intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The target field is identifiable and safe to read. Expected role and mapping are readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects literal doubled-label filtering while preserving the intended Type 2 field.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps canonical mapping and enum safeguards while correcting capability to FULLY AUTOMATABLE.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Adds raw enumeration provenance and explicit separation from chassis type and feature metadata.

review_improvement: Avoids an empty grep result and prevents a board type from the wrong record or SMBIOS structure from being accepted.
independent_technical_reasoning: After the canonical mapping and expected board role are supplied, every core operation is software-controlled; the editorial label defect does not require manual execution or blocking.
